planets.name: WASP-104 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-104 with a 1.76-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-104 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-104. Its orbit and size follow Smith et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SMITH_ET_AL__2014): disc_year 2014, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.75540563, pl_radj 1.137, pl_bmassj 1.272

quotes.title: WASP-104b
quotes.card: WASP-104b is a hot Jupiter exoplanet that orbits the star WASP-104.
quotes.introduction: It is considered to be one of the darkest exoplanets discovered.
